name: Konbini
source:
Main character lives in Chiba Prefecture and gets a job at a food shop. But he suffers from loneliness and is about to go to Okinawa where his neighbor Shinichi is supposed to get a job. But suddenly Shinichi arrives at the same food shop, and days obtain a much brighter coloring.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/02/vn-of-month-march-2001.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主人公住在千叶县，在一家食品店找到工作。但他饱受孤独之苦，正打算前往冲绳——他的邻居慎一据说要在那里工作。可突然间，慎一来到同一家食品店，日子也顿时明亮起来。

[来源：[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/02/vn-of-month-march-2001.html]vndbreview[/url]]
